about: Source-label audit of every real-text source row behind the F7 part of fix2 (q35_4b_main500k_fix2), done on 2 Oct 2026 after blind read 3 found 4 wrong golds, all of them source labels (yn2b/F7_BLIND_READ_3.md). Round 1 read every source row of the pre-audit F7 part (F7 v2 r4). Each later round read every source row of the pairs the r5 repair (golden_src/gen3/f7_repair_r5.py) newly selected that no earlier round had read. Each row's source label was checked against the F7 card the ladder shows. 'wrong_gold': the text contradicts the label. 'ambiguous': the text fits another card label as well, or the card wording leaves the label open. Both kinds are dropped: every flagged row is in yn2b/f7_fix2_drops.json, F7 r5 never selects a pair built from one, build_fix2 drops any such pair and every golden replay unit that holds one. Read by Claude (the data author); no model was used.
